newsitem.title: USA: Roberts Pharma files gastrointestinal IND.
newsitem.headline: Roberts Pharma files gastrointestinal IND.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said Wednesday that it has filed with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration an Investigational New Drug Application for LY315535, one of the new gastrointestinal compounds it recently acquired from Eli Lilly and Co.

In a press release, Roberts said it plans to develop the compound for the treatment of Functional Bowel Disorders (FDB), a potentially large and unsatisfied gastrointestinal market that includes Irritable Bowel Syndrome and non-ulcer dyspepsia.
A common feature of FDB is an abnormal intestinal motility pattern that can lead to a variety of symptoms, including constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, and abdominal pain.
According to Roberts, it has been estimated that 15 to 20 percent of the world population has FBD and that the worldwide market approximates 900 million days of therapy per year.
